title: V3.4 External Facility Acquisition Manifest Schema
description: Schema for physical facility data packages, camera parameters, and cryptographic asset integrity manifests.

source_name.description: Name of the data provider or organization.

source_uri.description: Provenance URI, repository, or archive URL.

camera_count.description: Total number of synchronized camera streams.

resolution.description: Standard video resolution formatted as WIDTHxHEIGHT (e.g. 1920x1080).

fps.description: Nominal video acquisition frames per second.

synchronization_method.description: Method utilized to synchronize multiple camera streams.

synchronization_error_ms.description: Upper bound on inter-camera synchronization error in milliseconds.

calibration_available.description: Whether surveyed camera calibration matrices are supplied.

lux_available.description: Whether physical hardware lux logs are supplied.

bbox_gt_available.description: Whether independent human detection ground truth is supplied.

trajectory_gt_available.description: Whether independent human trajectory ground truth is supplied.

intervention_gt_available.description: Whether adjudicated safety intervention labels are supplied.

sha256_manifest.description: Mapping from relative file path to its 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest.
